اعتقلوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَلُوا (iʕtaqalū) /iʕ.ta.qa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اُعْتُقِلُوا (uʕtuqilū) /uʕ.tu.qi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اِعْتَقِلُوا (iʕtaqilū) /iʕ.ta.qi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
